check_config_paths_exist: check if dataset config paths exist for a SemanticAudioNav dataset configuration
get_scenes_to_load: get list of scene ids to load from a SemanticAudioNav dataset configuration
dedup_goals: deduplicate goals across episodes and build a goals_by_category mapping from a dataset dict
to_json: serialize a SemanticAudioNavDataset instance to a JSON string with deduplicated goals
from_json: deserialize a JSON string into SemanticAudioGoalNavEpisode objects and append to the dataset
